statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low because current Asian trade is mixed and no sufficiently current independent source confirms persistent one-way NQ structure; oil near $107 and Treasury yields around 5% keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The main near-term checkpoint is the 12:30 UTC Empire State release through the first full U.S. cash-session hour; higher Tail states remain conditional on observed directional efficiency, shallow pullbacks or failed retracements.
headline: Low Tail persists while oil, yields and semiconductor weakness keep Stress extreme
body: Fresh Reuters reporting shows mixed Asian equities, Brent near $107 and the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield around the 5% threshold. Monday's 5.9% semiconductor-index decline remains a vulnerability. Without verified persistent one-way NQ structure, Tail stays low while cross-asset Stress remains extreme.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC clock hours, Tail began elevated through Monday's overnight and early U.S. session, peaked at 32%, then fell as substantial mean reversion emerged. WATCH persisted at 16-17 UTC and briefly at 20 UTC; Tail stayed low from 21 UTC through 04 UTC.
outlookSummary: Current Tail remains low because Asian risk is mixed and persistent one-way NQ structure is not independently verified. Conditional risk rises into the 12:30 UTC Empire State release and 13:30 UTC cash open, peaking at 24% WATCH only if price discovery becomes persistently directional with shallow or failed retracements.
